title: Matchings and Near-Optimal 2-Factor Packings in Percolated Vertex-Transitive Graphs
summary: Let $G$ be a connected simple vertex-transitive graph on $n$ vertices with degree $d$, and let $G_p$ be the random spanning subgraph obtained by retaining each edge of $G$ independently with probability $p$. Put $q:=1-p$. Motivated by a conjecture of Bedert, Draganić, Müyesser, and Pavez-Signé on Hamilton cycles in percolated Cayley graphs, we establish the corresponding matching and $2$-factor statements uniformly over the larger class of all connected vertex-transitive host graphs.
